description: ChatBackend::generate_invite_code has a default impl that uses nanosecond wall-clock time — NOT a CSPRNG. The docs say 'Production backends MUST override', but there is no compile-time enforcement. A backend author who does not read the docs ships guessable invite codes. Consider removing the default impl and requiring backends to provide their own, OR add a cfg(test) flag to the insecure path.
title: generate_invite_code default impl is insecure and opt-in to fix
